subject: Post-demo: cost run-rate & target $/1M benchmarking for MedSync
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@medsync.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: cost run-rate & target $/1M benchmarking for MedSync

Hi Elena — thanks again for carving out time this morning. Quick recap and clear asks so we can move toward a commercial pilot.

Call highlights (short):
- Primary workload: clinical summarization + triage prompts (avg seq length ~750 tokens).
- Expected steady-state: 35–45M tokens/month; peak bursts up to ~120M in event windows.
- Security: SOC 2 Type II required; will need KMS/HSM notes for private deployment.

Pricing / budget signals we captured on the call:
- Procurement-level target range: $2.5k–$6k/month initially (you mentioned an initial budget band)
- That implies target unit economics around $30–$90 per 1M tokens depending on commit and model selection.
- You called out a target aspiration closer to $35/1M if latency & quality align.

Our ask / next steps:
1) Can you confirm expected monthly run-rate for the next 3 months (steady vs peak)?
2) Confirm the procurement contact and timeline (PO, contract owner).
3) I attached a short benchmarking grid that shows where Redwood sits vs common hosts and a pilot price we typically offer for this profile.

Benchmark summary (quick take):
- Current public host reference (examples): OpenAI range ~ $40–$60 per 1M for comparable workloads, Anthropic often a touch higher for safety-tuned models; several open-model hosts run $20–$45/1M depending on quantization & batching.
- Key delta: Redwood’s routing + KV caching reduces effective token spend for repeat prompts, so effective $/1M can be materially lower for steady workloads.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-grid.xlsx (spreadsheet, candidate pilot tiers)

If you’re comfortable, I’ll draft a one-page pilot proposal and loop in Contracts.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183

From: Elena Morales <elena@medsync.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medsync.ai>
Date: 2027-04-20T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: cost run-rate & target $/1M benchmarking for MedSync

Thanks, Karthik — useful recap. A couple clarifications from our side:

- Run-rate: we expect a pilot ramp: month1 ~ 20–30M, month2 ~ 35–50M, month3 steady ~40M. The 120M bursts are rare (quarterly clinical drives).
- Budget: finance is allocating $5k–$8k/month for the pilot phase but prefers unit economics closer to $35/1M. They are ok with a slightly higher initial rate if we can show predictable token-normalized costs.
- Security/procurement: procurement@medsync.ai is the owner; their timeline is ~2–3 weeks to review standard security artifacts + SOW. SOC2 Type II is mandatory; any additional privacy addendum will be evaluated.

Please share the pilot SOW + price grid and a short note on what telemetry we’d get (per-route latency & token counts).

—Elena
VP Product, MedSync
elena@medsync.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@medsync.ai>
Date: 2027-04-20T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: cost run-rate & target $/1M benchmarking for MedSync

Elena — thanks for the clarity. Per your ask I’m attaching the benchmarking grid and a first-pass pilot proposal. TL;DR pricing options we modeled for the pilot: 

Pilot price scenarios (all per 1M tokens; pilot = 3 months):
- Economy pilot (no commit): $45/1M (gives flexibility, higher unit)
- Committed trial (3-month minimum, 40M committed/mo): $35/1M (matches your target if commit holds)
- Strategic pilot (6-month/volume guarantee + routing optimizations): $28/1M for first 6 months (best effective); then reverts to negotiated baseline.

Comparative rationale (short):
- OpenAI / Anthropic references: public Web prices can sit in the $40–$70/1M neighborhood for safety/tuned models; many third-party hosts claim lower list prices but often require heavier engineering to match latency/throughput.
- Redwood advantages that move the needle: prefix caching (up to ~30–40% fewer tokens on repeat prompts), continuous batching on burst windows, and curated model variants that preserve quality at lower compute cost. Those combine to reduce your effective spend vs naive host calls.

Attachments included: redwood-pricing-grid.xlsx (pricing tiers + example run-rate calc), SOC2-summary.pdf (security snapshot).

Telemetry: per-route token counts, per-token latency distribution, and per-request model variant used will be available in the Console during the pilot. We can provide a daily CSV export of token invoicing for finance.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm which pilot scenario (economy / committed 3-mo / strategic 6-mo).
2) Procurement reviews attached SOC2 summary and confirms contract owner + PO process.
3) If committed, we’ll kick off a 30-minute SOW review + security call this week and spin up pilot infra.

If you’d like, I can draft the SOW and share a DocuSign-ready quote to get procurement moving.

—Karthik
(Attachment: redwood-pricing-grid.xlsx, SOC2-summary.pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Elena — Ben here from Commercial. Appreciate the transparency on budget. A couple concrete concessions to help accelerate a pilot: 

- Offer: We can commit to $28/1M for the first 6 months if MedSync signs a 6-month pilot SOW with a 40M committed monthly baseline. That includes the routing/caching configuration and the telemetry package noted by Karthik.
- If you prefer a lower commitment, we can do a 3-month committed trial at $34/1M.

Process items:
- I’ll share a one-page commercial summary via DocuSign (link below) and a draft SOW for legal.
- Procurement: please confirm if MedSync requires any vendor-specific security addenda or custom PII language; if not, standard Redwood terms + SOC2 attachment usually clear in 2 weeks.

DocuSign quote: https://www.docusign.com/ems/xyz/SIGNATURE-REQ-8721
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/MEDS-3921
